semantic.justification: Consumed paragraph/run groups, native CR finish protocol, three script families, typed character/paragraph properties and style toggle semantics. Imported-style values are read through DomainMapper_Impl, not Writer pooled-style UNO defaults. The represented non-numbered paragraph/run slice is partial; style application, numbering/table/section/theme managers and unconsumed property cases remain pending. Whole-module parity stays unverified and DOCX application/UI import/export is not yet established. V4DQJW adds original kern modifier boolean projection nIntValue !=0, preserving the native minimum-size-threshold collapse (WRITER125). Word-only underline retains its separate true-only insertion and later-type behavior (WRITER126). The actual native item pool/UNO/primary storage path is now supported for these two bool properties. S3HW1E native property-presence checkpoint: RTFReferenceProperties now derives from genuine SvRefBase; RTFValue.getProperties returns an actual owned ReferencePointer backed by existing tools::SvRef. Mapper nested-property consumers release only these returned pointer temporaries in finally blocks; borrowed Stream.props and existing host-owned OOXML references retain their contracts. RTF materialization uses an actual SwXTextDocument/DomainMapper and real SwPaM ranges; admitted bold, italic, font size, ASCII font, color, underline/color and kerning resource trees reach the original PropertyMap and SetPropertyValues with source insertTextPortion NOFORMATATTR, preserving explicit native item presence instead of a value-difference filter. Original raw style rPr references remain distinct from materialized SwAttrSet ancestry; flattening copies rPr children without following parents. Default style0 insertion, first-entry table insertion and numeric entry order follow source. Parent/follow controls capture currently known source names, preserving empty non-forced RTFValue query zero (WRITER206). Targeted real-owner tests cover later style edits, parent references, script scope and exceptional pointer-return cleanup. Full native parser-property state, style application through native style-table/UNO owners, non-admitted character and paragraph/table property families, replay/substreams, complete script import/export and earlier TXT/RTF/Markdown/HTML obligations remain open. Existing named-style materialization and remaining callbacks are not certified as full upstream contracts; duplicate-ID/name selection is unverified. No full native Writer/mapper ABI or whole-filter parity promotion. S3HW1E RTF strike/highlight checkpoint: original explicit SourceDocumentType now selects RTF integer highlight colors versus OOXML palette tokens, and character-style highlights follow the original mapper exclusion. RTF parser groups and emitted run snapshots own genuine RTFSprms copies for strike/dstrike/highlight; ordered independent toggle values, overwrite positions, native COW and native normalization replace the collapsed strike DTO as the materialization input. Plain clears the admitted modifier state. Actual style/run mapper vectors retain direct zero-valued items and native equal-value deduplication. Existing difference-based strike/highlight item creation was removed; escapement remains on its prior path pending a concrete position/inheritance fix. Actual group members and all queued paragraph/table snapshots release at the atomic reader lifetime boundary, including parse errors. Tests exercise valid RTF inputs, inherited/direct values and source-profile colors, rather than requiring unrelated module API completeness. Whole native parser state and unconsumed factory/UNO/module operations are not claimed complete and are not independent filter completion gates.
